sloka: तावुभौ युगपद्वीरौ हनुमद्राक्षसोत्तमौ।उल्काहस्तौ तदा रात्रौ रणशीर्षे विचेरतुः ।। ६.७४.७ ।।
transliteration: tāvubhau yugapadvīrau hanumadrākṣasottamau।ulkāhastau tadā rātrau raṇaśīrṣe viceratuḥ ।। 6.74.7 ।।

translations.english: The two heroes, Hanuman and Vibheeshana, and the foremost of Rakshasas with torch in hand searched for the left over Vanaras in the battlefield.
